# Complaints and feedback

We want to hear when something has gone wrong, so we can put it right.

## How to make a complaint

Make a complaint through your online account, by email or by calling customer service. We will
acknowledge it within two business days and aim to resolve it within 15 business days.

## If you are not satisfied

If you are not satisfied with how we handled your complaint, you can contact the independent
dispute resolution scheme for our industry. It is free to use.
